summary: Avery Dennison filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting routine Board leadership succession. Effective September 1, 2026, William Wagner becomes independent Board Chair; Mitchell Butier steps down as non-executive Chairman but remains a non-independent director. Patrick Siewert ceases as Lead Independent Director and replaces Wagner as Governance Committee Chair. These planned governance transitions reflect long-term succession planning, not an abrupt departure or strategic event. No special-situation transaction, activist involvement, or financial terms are involved, so the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
